title: The greeting that is a wish
told: a saying of the Prophet ﷺ

hook.say: before the story, can i ask you something? when you meet someone, what’s the first thing you usually say?
options: hi is good. today, a hello that carries a gift.
a kind question. today, one that comes with a wish.
fair. today’s greeting is for everyone, known or not.

steps.line: A saying of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ tells that when God created Adam, the first human, He said to him: go and greet that gathering of angels.
“Listen to how they answer you,” God told him. “That will be your greeting, and your children’s greeting.”

steps.q: What do you think the very first greeting was?
steps.why: Peace be upon you. The very first greeting was a wish.

steps.line: Adam said, “As-salamu alaykum,” peace be upon you. The angels answered, “Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God.”

steps.q: Why does it matter that the angels added “and the mercy of God”?
o: It was a holier greeting, just for angels
They gave back more than they got
steps.why: They returned more than they were given. That’s how the greeting is meant to travel.

steps.line: The Qur’an makes it a rule: when someone greets you, answer with something better, or at least give the same back.

steps.q: A saying of the Prophet ﷺ sets out who should offer salaam first. Who greets whom?
steps.why: The rider greets the walker, the walker the one sitting, the few greet the many, the younger the older. Whoever can, offers peace first.

steps.line: The Prophet ﷺ told his companions: you won’t truly believe until you love one another. And what grows that love? Spread salaam among yourselves.
Today, at a shop or an airport gate, one says, “As-salamu alaykum.” The other answers straight back, “Wa alaykum as-salam.” And upon you, peace.
steps.label: today

steps.q: At the gate, a stranger says “As-salamu alaykum.” You want to give it back bigger, like the angels. What do you say?
steps.why: “And upon you peace, and the mercy of God”: the angels’ own answer. Many add “wa barakatuh,” and his blessings, to go bigger still.

say: here’s what i love. in this story, the very first words between adam and the angels weren’t a question or a name. they were a wish.
in islam, salaam is given first and given back bigger. the prophet ﷺ said love grows from it, so you don’t wait to feel close before you greet.

steps.q: Salaam, Islam and Muslim share the same root letters, s-l-m. So what does the word Islam itself mean?
o: Surrender, and the peace in it
steps.why: Salaam is peace. Islam is surrender to God, and the peace found in it. A Muslim is one who surrenders. Every greeting carries the faith’s own name.

today.say: today, greet one person first, before they greet you. a saying teaches that the one who greets first is nearest to God. say “salaam” if it fits, or wish them peace in your own words. and when someone greets you, give it back a little bigger.
options: lovely. that’s the whole lesson, said out loud.
beautiful. that’s exactly what the angels did.

card.keepWhy: Give peace first. Give it back bigger.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 3326 and 6227; Sahih Muslim 2841 (God created Adam and said: go and greet that group of angels sitting there and listen to how they greet you, for that is your greeting and your offspring’s; he said “as-salamu ‘alaykum”; they said “as-salamu ‘alayka wa rahmatullah,” adding “wa rahmatullah”)
Qur’an 4:86 (“When ye are greeted with a greeting, greet ye with a better than it or return it,” Pickthall), paraphrased
Sahih Muslim 54 (you will not believe until you love one another; shall I tell you something that, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread salaam among yourselves)
Sunan Abi Dawud 5197 (the people nearest to Allah are those who begin the greeting of salaam)
Root s-l-m (salam, islam, muslim): Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon
check: Adam is called “the first human”; in Islam he is also the first prophet. The lesson follows week one’s style (Ibrahim, Jibril) and adds no honorific. Confirm.
Paintings SM1-SM3 show the angels only as soft points of light in a garden, no figures, and no Adam. Confirm this is acceptable.
